_instructions: This is the template for /visualize graph data. Claude fills this in based on project analysis. Delete _instructions and _field_guide before saving the final version.

_field_guide.mode: self (ClaudeBoost self-map) or project (target repo analysis)
_field_guide.groups: Array of {id, label, color} defining node categories
_field_guide.nodes: Array of node objects — see node_field_guide below
_field_guide.edges: Array of {source, target, kind, label} — kinds: calls, spawns, reads, writes, depends, triggers, composes

node_field_guide.label: Display name shown in the box
node_field_guide.kind: agent | knowledge | hook | state | command | service | module | datastore | external
node_field_guide.purpose: One sentence explaining what this does
node_field_guide.details_md: Optional long-form markdown for the drawer (pre-rendered to HTML by render.py)
